description: This PHP script handles the creation and saving of dynamic custom fields in the SuiteCRM/Dashboard CRM extension. It interacts with DynamicField and AddField classes to generate HTML for custom fields and updates the layout accordingly.

classes.name: DynamicField
classes.description: Represents a dynamic custom field object used to setup, add fields, and generate HTML for custom fields.

classes.name: AddField
classes.description: Represents a utility for adding a new field to the layout and generating associated scripts.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the DynamicField object with the module's bean.

methods.name: addField
methods.description: Adds a new custom field with specified parameters.

methods.name: getFieldHTML
methods.description: Returns the HTML code for the specified field.

methods.name: getFieldLabelHTML
methods.description: Returns the HTML label for the specified field.

methods.name: add_field
methods.description: Adds a new field to the form layout.

methods.name: get_script
methods.description: Returns JavaScript to support the new field.
